intro.h2: The crew people call when a job has to be done right
paragraphs: Kinley Remodeling is a remodeling contractor in Erie led by Will, who works with his own crew on kitchens, bathrooms, floors and front entries. The common thread in the reviews is careful tile work and a crew that respects your home.

Some customers come to Kinley after something went wrong. One family needed someone to step in and finish a kitchen remodel after an unexpected contractor crisis. Another had an old tile shower floor that was leaking, and Will's crew replaced it so it is 100% waterproof. Customers say the crew shows up on time, keeps the workspace spotless and asks for their input along the way.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling and backsplashes
items.blurb: Kitchen updates from new countertops and sinks to tile backsplashes with under-cabinet lighting. Will even stepped in to finish one family's kitchen remodel after an unexpected contractor crisis, and they called his tile work fantastic.

image.alt: White kitchen cabinets with glass doors, gray and taupe stone countertop and white subway tile backsplash under LED lighting

items.name: Shower floors and tile showers
items.blurb: Leaking tile shower floors torn out and rebuilt so they are fully waterproof. One rebuilt shower got a pebble mosaic floor with a square drain, large white wall tile and a clean white curb with a glass panel.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with pebble mosaic floor, square drain, large white wall tiles, white curb, glass panel and gray stone-look floor tile

items.name: Flooring
items.blurb: New floors through living rooms, dining rooms and basements, as one reviewer describes. Kinley lays wood-look flooring through hallways and around staircases, with neat transitions at doorways and fresh white baseboard, so the new floor looks finished from room to room.

image.alt: Dark wood-look plank flooring running through a hallway beside a staircase with black railing

items.name: Porticos and front entries
items.blurb: Exterior entry work such as a portico over the front door. Candie's brick ranch went from a bare concrete step to a covered entry with white columns and a gabled roof, built with her input at each step.

image.alt: New white portico with gabled roof and columns over the front door of a brick ranch house

items.title: Fixes other people's problems
items.text: Karen's family hired Will to finish their kitchen remodel after an unexpected contractor crisis. They wrote that the crew was professional, timely and sensitive to their situation.

items.text: Bill's leaking shower floor became a highlight of his bathroom. He noticed the attention to small details and the care taken to make everything 100% waterproof.

items.title: On time with a clean workspace
items.text: Reviewers say the crew showed up on time every day and kept the workspace spotless. Google also tags four reviews for efficiency and two for promptness.

items.title: Your input along the way
items.text: Candie said Will sought her input throughout her portico project and communication with him was excellent. She plans to call him for future projects.

about.h2: About Will and the Kinley crew
about.text: Kinley Remodeling works out of Chelsea Avenue in Erie. Will runs the jobs with his own crew, and customers keep mentioning the same things: excellent communication, a professional crew and work that is worth the wait. His projects range from shower floors and backsplashes to full kitchens, new flooring and a portico over a front door. Several customers say they will call Will again for future home projects, and the business holds a 5.0 rating from 31 Google reviews, with 68 photos on its profile.

items.name: Karen B.
items.text: Highly recommend for quality work. Wil was willing to step in and finish our kitchen remodel after an unexpected contractor crisis.  Wil and crew were professional, timely and sensitive to our situation.  His tile work was fantastic. We will definitely call Wil for any future  home projects.Thanks again Wil.

items.name: Bill K.
items.text:
I couldn’t be happier with the shower floor replacement done by Kinley Remodeling. Our old tile was leaking, but Kinley Remodeling transformed it into a highlight of our bathroom.
The craftsmanship is top-notch. They were incredibly professional, showed up on time every day, and kept the workspace spotless. It’s rare to find someone who pays this much attention to the small details and ensures everything is 100% waterproof. If you need tile or remodeling done right, I highly recommend them!

items.name: Candie S.
items.text: I contracted with Kinley Remodeling to build a portico over our front entrance. While it took a little longer than anticipated, it was worth the wait! Love it! It is exactly what I wanted. Will was great to work with and communication with him was excellent. He sought my input throughout the process. His crew was very professional. I will definitely call Will for future projects.

service_area.text: Kinley Remodeling is based at 1411 Chelsea Ave in Erie, PA, and works on homes around the city: kitchens, bathrooms, floors and front entries. If you live in or near Erie and want to know whether Will can take on your project, call (724) 301-7571 any day between 9 AM and 8 PM with your address and a few details.

items.q: Can you finish a remodel another contractor started?
items.a: Yes. Karen's family hired Will to step in and finish their kitchen remodel after an unexpected contractor crisis. They wrote that Will and his crew were professional, timely and sensitive to their situation, and that his tile work was fantastic. Call to describe where your project stands.

items.q: My tile shower floor is leaking. Can you fix it?
items.a: Yes. Kinley Remodeling replaced Bill's leaking tile shower floor and he says it is now a highlight of his bathroom. He noted how much attention went into small details and into making sure everything is 100% waterproof. Send a photo of your shower to start.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Kitchen remodels, backsplash installation, tile showers and shower floors, flooring in living rooms, dining rooms and basements, and exterior entry work such as a portico over a front door. If your project is something else, call and ask whether it fits.

Kinley Remodeling is open every day of the week from 9 AM to 8 PM, including weekends. Call (724) 301-7571 during those hours, or email willhopkins269@gmail.com at any time with photos and a description of your project, and Will can get back to you.

The business address is 1411 Chelsea Ave, Erie, PA 16505, and the projects shown here are around Erie. If you live outside the city, call with your address and Will can tell you whether your project is within reach for his crew.

final_cta.text: Call Will to talk about your kitchen, shower, floors or front entry.
